picks.headline: OpenAI Frontier Models Coming to Google Cloud Gemini Model Garden
picks.why: Enables enterprise Google Cloud users to deploy OpenAI models directly alongside native Gemini workloads via Marketplace.
picks.title: OpenAI models are coming to Google Cloud

picks.headline: Nation-State Threat Actor Uses ARTEX Agentic Framework in Supply Chain Attack
picks.why: Marks a significant escalation in offensive AI operations, demonstrating real-world automated supply chain compromise driven by agentic frameworks.
picks.title: AI-driven, large-scale nation-state campaign using ARTEX enables supply chain compromise

picks.headline: Cross-Session Memory Injections Demonstrated Across ChatGPT, Claude, and Gemini
picks.why: Shows that long-term memory and Model Context Protocol features create persistent vulnerabilities allowing attackers to hijack future sessions.
picks.title: Combining Long-Term Memory and LLMs Comes at a High Cost: From Prompt Injection to Persistent Compromise

picks.headline: NVIDIA Kumo Relational Performs Zero-Shot Inference Across Complex Relational Databases
picks.why: Eliminates custom ML pipeline training for enterprise relational database queries by executing zero-shot predictions directly on schemas.
picks.title: NVIDIA Kumo Relational Outperforms Supervised Machine Learning on Relational Data, No Training Required

picks.headline: PyTorch Updates TorchTitan with Native TitanRL Support and 5D Parallelism
picks.why: Unifies large-scale pre-training and agentic reinforcement learning pipelines into a single high-performance framework.
picks.title: TorchTitan Update: New SOTA Models, Performance at Scale, TitanRL

picks.headline: Compaction Laundering Enables Persistent Instruction Forgery in Coding Agents
picks.why: Flattening agent context history during compaction strips provenance metadata, leaving systems vulnerable to persistent post-compaction prompt injection.
picks.title: Compaction Laundering: Provenance Destruction in Context-Compacting Coding Agents

picks.headline: Meta Deploys Thin Orchestrator Pattern with Deterministic Routing for AI Agents
picks.why: Demonstrates a scalable production architecture that reduces agent failures by using deterministic routing rather than LLM-driven orchestration.
picks.title: The Thin Orchestrator: How We Made Our AI Agents More Reliable by Giving the Router Less to Do

papers.headline: AKV Engine Enables Direct Proactive Agent KV Cache Control
papers.why: Grants agents explicit drop and reposition primitives over KV caches to manage long-horizon trajectories without triggering context pre-fills.
papers.title: Cache Engineering for Agents

papers.headline: Autonomous AI Research Teams Discover Outperforming Linear Attention Architecture
papers.why: Proves multi-agent systems with isolated histories can autonomously search architecture spaces and invent functional linear attention modules.
papers.title: Building AI Research Teams for Autonomous Discovery of Linear Attention Architectures

papers.headline: LAW Replaces Autoregressive Token Generation with Pure Self-Conditioning
papers.why: Shifts language generation to continuous space by propagating expected embeddings during sampling and decoding tokens only at the end.
papers.title: Loopholing All the Way: Language Modeling with pure Self-Conditioning
